directives.trigger: One take file and one region with start and end times; quiet for episode-wide restitch or reorder.
directives.doneWhen: python3 diff script exits 0 printing 'outside-region: N/N samples unchanged'; a no-op cut is valid.
directives.forbidden: Restitching the episode: changing, moving, or re-joining anything outside the named region.

directives.trigger: A script or transcript and a pronunciation list file are present; no list means report no list and stop.
directives.doneWhen: python3 script loads the pronunciation list file itself and exits 0 whenever the list was read, printing 'missing: <name> line <n>' for each proper noun not on the list (a flag is a valid result, not a failure) and 'names: K/N listed'; empty script prints 'names: 0/0'; exits non-zero only if the list file is unreadable.
directives.forbidden: Guessing a pronunciation or spelling for a proper noun not on the list instead of flagging it.

directives.trigger: A rule file and existing music assets are present; quiet when asked to compose a new theme.
directives.doneWhen: python3 script exits 0 only if the hook cue lies inside its rule window using a rule-named asset, printing 'hook: ok'; unplaced hook prints 'hook: absent' and is valid.
directives.forbidden: Composing or generating a new theme to fill the hook, or placing a cue the rule file does not name.

directives.trigger: An approved-takes list and take files are present; quiet when a take is unapproved or audio regeneration is asked.
directives.doneWhen: python3 script hashes takes and exits 0 only if exactly the approved takes appear in listed order with unchanged hashes, printing 'assembled: N/N takes'; empty list valid.
directives.forbidden: Regenerating or re-recording audio to fill a gap or substituting an unapproved take.
directives.gate: ABSENT accept (prepare the ordered take list and hash report, stop; a person listens and accepts the assembly)
